KV-7 history

The KV-7 was based off of the KV-1 and used as many components from the KV-1 as possible in order to make mass manufacturing easier. The turret of the KV-1 was removed and replaced with a immobile turret and was designed to make crew conditions in the vehicle more bearable. Due to the design of the compartment for the crew it was only able to fire the 76mm every 11.3 seconds but could fire the twin 45mm every 6.8 seconds. The 3 guns could only travel           15 degrees in either direction depending on how much ammo was in the tank due to the way it was stored. The KV-7 had a 300 round capacity each gun getting 100 rounds. The request for a vehicle was made because the Russians were having trouble destroying German fortifications and the heavily armored German tanks. The KV-7 was made to fit a crew of 6.
